items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of a headworks with one mechanical bar screen, a backup manual screen, a backup comminutor, ...
The headworks also includes a backup communator and a manual bar rake for screenings.
The influent pump station is equipped with three dry pit submersible pumps with a pumping capacity of 2.5 MGD each.
Complete Mix Activated Sludge: Flow from the headworks is distributed evenly between the two 420,000-gallon aeration basins.
Secondary Clarifiers: Flow from aeration basins enters a distribution box, dividing the flow to each clarifier.
The treatment system at the Facility consists of ... one ballast pond to equalize flow to the pressure filters, ...
The treatment system at the Facility consists of ... three pressurized multi-media filtration units, ...
Chlorination: Two chlorinators supply a gas solution for disinfection with a maximum feed rate of 400 lbs/day. The dose is applied at the beginning of the 134,000-gallon chlorine contact chamber.

De-chlorination: The effluent discharged from the chlorine contact chamber is dosed with a sodium bisulfite solution. The sodium bisulfite neutralizes any remaining chlorine to have a zero-chlorine residual, leaving the Facility.
The Facility has two aerobic digesters. Digester No. 1 has a capacity of 256,000 gallons, and Digester No. 2 has a capacity of 453,000 gallons. Currently, only Digester No. 2 is online.

Ponds are dewatered in the spring to an empty pond. The solids are dried in the pond or in conjunction with the drying beds ... The drying beds have an underdrain system that flows back to the headworks.
Sludge Stabilization Ponds and Drying Beds: Ponds receive digester decant, wasting, and filter backwash flows. The ponds are decanted back to the headworks at a maximum flow of 0.04 MGD.
Once the sludge has dried in ponds and beds, it is removed and trucked to the landfill.

Backwash rates are 18,000 gallons to 25,000 gallons per backwash. A typical backwash occurs every 24 to 72 hours. Backwash flow is typically sent to the sludge stabilization ponds or can be routed to either aeration basins.

Emergency Storage Pond : The Facility’s emergency storage pond is only used in the event of catastrophic mechanical failures ... The emergency storage pond stays empty year-round, not accounting for any rainfall accumulation.
